summary: Gambling.com Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 14, 2026, announcing financial results and an AI transformation-led restructuring. The company plans to reduce its workforce by 25%, yielding $13 million in annualized savings, with half expected by H2 2026. No price per share, premium, or deal terms are specified as this is an operational restructure, not a transaction. The board supports the plan, and no advisors are named. This is a cost-cutting initiative to improve margins, not a special situation like an acquisition or spin-off. Watch for execution risk and revenue recovery from organic search and regulatory headwinds.
